meta.title: Loop watchdog
meta.description: Detects dead-loop turns — no output, or reasoning spinning without visible results — breaks them and wakes the agent to continue until the task is done. Never interrupts while waiting for the user.
meta.detail: Tiered detection: streamed text and tool activity count as visible progress and reset all timers; reasoning-only output is judged against a shorter thinkingStallMs; full silence against stallMs. On a stall it cancels the stuck turn and injects a change-of-strategy follow-up, unlimited by default with the counter reset on real progress. While a question or approval dialog awaits the user, the watchdog is fully frozen.
